Frequently Asked Questions

What does Change Image DPI do?
It changes the DPI metadata stored with an image.
Does changing DPI add image quality?
No. It changes the DPI value without creating additional pixels.
Will my pixel dimensions change?
No. The image width and height in pixels stay the same.
What DPI values can I use?
You can enter a custom DPI or choose common values such as 72, 96, 150, 200, 300 and 600.
Is Change Image DPI free?
Yes. It is free to use.
